description: The painting shows a woman in a worn trench coat and headscarf dropping a folded ballot into a glass box at a wooden table. Behind her a line of women in shawls and headscarves waits in a high-ceilinged room with a carved doorway. Tricolour flags hang on the walls, and a grey-haired man in a dark suit sits at the table beside the box. The style is a realistic oil painting with no visible text, frame or border.
